result.rationale: Diff shows `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` in update and destroy with no nil check; save_host would raise NoMethodError on `host.host=` and destroy calls `host.destroy` on nil, producing a 500 instead of 404 for nonexistent ids. Verifiable from the diff.

judged_text: update and destroy call .first on the id lookup and use the result with no nil guard: save_host(nil) raises NoMethodError on host.host=, and destroy calls nil.destroy. PUT/DELETE to /admin/embeddable_hosts/:id with a stale or nonexistent id (e.g. a second admin already deleted the host) returns a 500 from NoMethodError instead of the 404 the REST contract promises, surfacing as an ajax error popup blaming the acting admin.
